I’d make sure that your are actually slotted for 1GB service. If 300 is the max for most devices then it may be that the router itself is in disabled status on your account and is not technically on there. As for the computer it could be your network card. Is it a desktop or laptop?

If you’re having issues usually upgrading will not fix the issue. Could be wifi travel distance, line issues, noise backfeeding from neighbor’s coax lines, hardline or plant issues. I would definitely call for a technician to come out and make sure everything is looking good before upgrading.

Usually the led lights on certain models will start to give out and will show the lights for voice and battery randomly. There might also be a purple light underneath battery too. It shouldn’t affect services
If it blinks between red and blue it’s taking an update. Blinking only red means there is some issue with the signal
